text:
maria: heads-up: after the kernel-selection tweak last night we started seeing host parse CPU go up on streaming workloads, noticed in canary.
ajay: saw that too, reproducing locally. tail latency on 1-token messages spiked ~60%.
kevin: link to canary dashboards?
maria: https://grafana/reports/ingress/175432 — main delta is host_parse_ns median 1.5ms -> 2.4ms.
sara: is this coming from tokenization or proto unpack path?
ajay: quick profile points at `proto_unmarshal` + extra memcpy in the new kernel path. kernel changed how we represent framed buffers, accidentally added a copy for streaming fragments.
maria: confirmed with perf: sample stack top shows `runtime::parse_stream -> proto_unmarshal -> memcpy`.
kevin: that memcpy shouldn't be on the hot path. any immediate mitigations?
ajay: two short options: 1) revert kernel-selection change on canary (fast), 2) land a host-side zero-copy shim that reuses incoming buffer for proto decode (safer but more work).
sara: revert for now and open a PR for shim? ops would prefer revert until we have a test.
maria: +1 revert. i'll roll canary back and post the deploy.
runtime-bot: deploy started for service=ingress-canary tag=canary-revert-175432 commit=ab3c9de (ETA ~2m) :rocket:
kevin: while revert is rolling, ajay can you prototype the shim and a microbench? measure both CPU and KV cache interaction (we saw small KVCACHE miss bump too).
ajay: will do. plan: implement `decode_inplace` that reads framed proto off wire and returns a zero-copy message view; bench with our smallwrite HTTP/gRPC traces.
maria: also look at batching heuristics — the new kernel path shifts inter-token timing and our batcher starts smaller batches, increasing overhead.
ajay: good catch. adding a flag to prefer time-based accumulation when avg inter-arrival < 2ms should restore batch size. i'll include that tweak in the prototype.
sara: FYI alerting thresholds tripped in prod for 30m, we've paged oncall but revert reduces noise.
kevin: after shim + batching tweak, we should run long tail tests (24h) with mixed seq lengths to validate no regressions in KV cache hit-rate.
ajay: initial microbench (local docker jax) results:
```
before: host_parse_ns P50=1500 P95=3400 kvcache_hit=0.77
after-shim-proto: host_parse_ns P50=820 P95=1200 kvcache_hit=0.78
batcher-time-pref: avg_batch_tokens 12 -> 28, token-cost down 18%
```
maria: promising. can you attach the perf flame and the minimal repro? put in PR description.
ajay: will push branch `perf/shim-decode-175432` with bench harness and flame graphs.
sara: once PR lands, coordinate with kevin to run canary again under traffic. we want to watch p99 decode CPU and KVCACHE eviction rate.
maria: thanks team — rolling revert done. follow-up: ajay/logs + kevin/canary-run. i'll update the incident thread after the second canary. :thumbsup:
